name: 1 Date Danger
source:
The video game equivalent of committing to the bit.

It's your first semester at the prestigious Lombardi University, and you've immediately dived head first into the chaos of organizing the student-run New Year festival. You befriend Trait, a kind but slightly disturbed rabbit, and his best friend Stoney, a perma-stoned dog who keeps up a strong emotional guard around new people. What will you do to win their hearts?

This game features characters from and many references to the band [url=https://1traitdanger.bandcamp.com/]1 Trait Danger[/url]. It's best that you have at least some knowledge of the band before playing. This is a satirical fanwork and is not officially associated with 1TD.

[From [url=https://mawedgone.itch.io/1-date-danger]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
电子游戏相当于致力于比特。

这是你在著名的隆巴迪大学的第一个学期，你立即投入到组织学生举办的新年节的混乱之中。你会和特质（一只善良但有点不安的兔子）和他最好的朋友斯托尼（一只永远被石头打死的狗，在新朋友面前保持强烈的情感警惕）成为朋友。你会做什么来赢得他们的心？

该游戏以乐队 [url=https://1traitdanger.bandcamp.com/]1 Trait Danger[/url] 中的角色为特色，并有许多参考资料。最好在演奏之前至少对乐队有一些了解。这是一部讽刺同人作品，与1TD没有正式关联。

[来自[url=https://mawedgone.itch.io/1-date-danger]Itch.io[/url]]
